# Refund desk

## State machine

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    Requested
    Assessed
    AwaitingApproval
    WithSupervisor
    Approved
    Paid
    PayoutFailed
    Declined
    Withdrawn
    [*] --> Requested
    AwaitingApproval --> Approved : ApproveRefund [role = Supervisor and assigned] / Audit:RefundApproved
    Approved --> Paid : ConfirmPayout [role = PaymentGateway] / Audit:RefundPaid, Notification:CustomerToldPaid
    AwaitingApproval --> Declined : DeclineRefund [role = Supervisor] / Audit:RefundDeclined, Notification:CustomerToldDeclined
    WithSupervisor --> Declined : DismissEscalation [role = Supervisor] / Audit:EscalationDismissed, Notification:CustomerToldDeclined
    AwaitingApproval --> WithSupervisor : EscalateStale [role = SlaTimer] / Audit:RefundEscalated, Notification:SupervisorPaged
    Approved --> PayoutFailed : FailPayout [role = PaymentGateway] / Audit:PayoutFailed
    Assessed --> AwaitingApproval : ProposeRefund [role = SupportAgent] / Audit:RefundProposed, Notification:SupervisorAsked
    WithSupervisor --> Approved : ResolveEscalation [role = Supervisor and assigned] / Audit:EscalationResolved
    PayoutFailed --> Approved : RetryPayout [role = Supervisor] / Audit:PayoutRetried
    Requested --> Assessed : AssessRequest [role = SupportAgent] / Audit:RefundTriaged
    Requested --> Withdrawn : Withdraw [role = Customer] / Audit:RequestWithdrawn
    Paid --> [*]
    Declined --> [*]
    Withdrawn --> [*]
```
